details.migration: The first live populated D1 migration exposed a foreign-key ordering defect. The migration now snapshots rows, renames the empty replacement to the final table name, and only then repopulates it. A second live D1/R2 run preserved all dependent rows, IDs, and exact bytes with zero foreign-key violations.
details.contentIngress: The isolated stack intentionally created no DNS records or custom domains. Durable static, SPA, and media data was verified in D1/R2, but Cloudflare HTTP routing and range behavior cannot be claimed until a temporary wildcard content domain is approved.
details.ownership: The isolated stack has no interactive human identity provider. Service-principal denial passed; the positive two-human flow remains gated on hosted authentication.
details.recovery: With source writes frozen, Wrangler exported and imported D1 into an empty database while a native Worker R2 binding copied all objects and their metadata into an empty bucket. The restored Worker reported health and readiness 200; 3/3 artifact and version IDs, 10/10 exact object bodies and metadata, and 5/5 immutable blobs passed. This proves the provider procedure, but the repository still needs an automated harness and operator runbook.
details.destroy: Every temporary Worker, D1 database, R2 bucket, and cron trigger was removed. The shared account-level Alchemy state Worker was not changed.
